# PurePersian — Persian lexical proposals for AI agents

> Machine-readable Persian glossary; suggestions need human/contextual review.

Project: https://github.com/thecompez/PurePersian
Agent policy: https://github.com/thecompez/PurePersian/blob/main/AGENTS.md
MCP implementation: https://github.com/thecompez/PurePersian/blob/main/purepersian_mcp/server.py
Data (JSON): https://github.com/thecompez/PurePersian/blob/main/purepersian_mcp/lexicon.json
Authoritative data: persian.tex and adverbs.tex
Schema: 1.0.0
MCP Python SDK: >=2,<3; transport: stdio; no remote host required.
MCP tools: lookup_term, search_terms, list_categories, glossary_stats, inspect_text.
MCP resources: purepersian://guide, purepersian://stats.
MCP prompt: context_aware_rewrite.

## Safety and semantics
There is no automatic rewriting. Alternatives are context-dependent, not certified synonyms.
Check each term's usage and source. Legacy rows need further editorial review.
Keep proper names and technical terms, preserve certainty, modality, register, and intent.
